# @three-ws/vision-mcp

> Let any AI agent see — analyze and describe images through the three.ws vision pipeline. Free NVIDIA NIM VLMs first, with an automatic server-side paid backstop. Pass an image URL or base64 and get a structured, natural-language read. Read-only, no key required.

@three-ws/vision-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/vision-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/vision-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/vision-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/vision-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/vision-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
